name: COVID-19 Short-Term Absence Payment
description: A payment scheme providing financial support for businesses and self-employed workers who cannot work because they or a dependant are required to stay home while awaiting a COVID-19 PCR test result.

attributes.summary: COVID-19 Short-Term Absence Payment supports businesses and self-employed workers when an employee must miss work while awaiting a COVID-19 PCR test result, including for dependants and specific employment situations. Payment is capped to one per 30-day period and must align with employment law.
attributes.eligibility: Eligible entities include businesses registered and operating in New Zealand, self-employed persons, and health and disability funded workforce. Ineligible entities include state sector organisations generally. Trigger conditions include employee awaiting COVID-19 PCR test result, dependant awaiting COVID-19 PCR test result, or staying home under public health guidance or requirements. Specific situations covered include people working multiple jobs, self-employed person also an employee, newly hired employees, people getting income from a property business, and workers temporarily overseas unable to return due to COVID-19 restrictions.
attributes.payment_details: Payment frequency is one payment in a 30-day period. Payment basis is ordinary wages or salary.
